lines.en: I walk on all fours with a little bounce.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫开地上的落叶。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the fallen leaves aside.

lines.zh: 我头顶的耳朵一抖一抖。
lines.en: The ears on my head twitch.
I've found a path on the mountain.
I move along the edge of the rocks.
My claws grip the mountain stone.
I pad over the fallen leaves, looking around.
I jog down the slope.

lines.zh: 我的影子在砾石上很短。
lines.en: My shadow is short on the gravel.
I head slowly toward the camp.
Paw prints trail after me.
I stop and flick my ears straight.
I sit with my tail on the ground.
I lick the dust off my paw pads.
I hear something far off.
I tilt my head at the sky.
My chest rises and falls.
I'm waiting for you to call me.
I turn my ears to one side.

lines.zh: 尘土进了鼻子，我打喷嚏
lines.en: Dust gets up my nose and I sneeze.
I lie in the sun.
I'm not asleep.
My claw tips tap the stone.
I glance at you, then lower my head.
I'm thinking about my next meal.
I've got energy to burn.
So you're my Tamer, then.
I'm waiting for your order.

lines.zh: 我可以坐下，也可以跟着你。
lines.en: I can sit, or I can follow you.
My teeth are sharp, you know.
I get noisy when I'm hungry.
Would you like to pat my head?
I know these mountains.
I've picked up another scent.
I don't like staying in one place.
If you go, I go.

lines.zh: 你的靴子磨破了，歇会儿吧
lines.en: Your boots are worn through, rest a while.
I'm ready whenever you are.
My tail has started wagging.
Who do you want me to bite?
I've been waiting for you to come back.
I understand everything you say.
I growl low and give half a step.
My hind leg is scraped and seeping blood.
I shake the gravel off my back.
The pain runs up along my back.
I don't like being hit.
I'm still standing firm.
I tuck my tail and step back.
I've edged closer to you.

lines.zh: 我站起来，重新压低身子
lines.en: I get up and drop into a crouch again.
I clamp my teeth shut and make no sound.
That smell of meat, I know it.
May I have some?
This smells very good.

lines.zh: 这点根本不够我垫肚子
lines.en: That won't even line my stomach.
Have you got anything else in your pocket?
I'll sit down and wait.
I'll try just a small bite first.
That isn't enough for me.
Hold it a bit lower.
I am holding myself back.
Thank you. Truly.
I lick my lips and want more.
You bump me; I give half a step.
My claws bite the ground and hold.
I nearly knocked you over.
I squeeze past, brushing your leg.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴擦过你的腿侧
lines.en: My tail brushes along your leg.
I shift back a small half step.
We each step back half a pace, both fine.
I rocked a little from that.

lines.zh: 你的靴跟压着我的爪子
lines.en: Your heel is on my claw.
I wag my tail and walk on.
There are other Digimon here too.
It licks the tip of my snout.
It comes up short of my shoulder.
We drank at the stream together.
Its eyes are a pale color.
We called out to each other a few times.
It runs faster.
I walk with it as far as the stream.
It went back first.
We'll meet again.
I take it in my jaws and run for camp.
This I can eat.
I pin it under a paw and crouch.
Anything on the ground, I carry off.
This is far too heavy.
I dig up the soil and hide it there.
I dug it up again.
I carry it back to camp.
This can't be chewed.
I'll stash it and eat later.
The smell ahead has changed.
I sink my body into the gravel.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵转向它的方向
lines.en: I swing my ears toward it.
This is no beast I know.
I'll cover you first.
I lunge in ahead of you to meet it.
I can handle this one.
I spread my claw tips.
I edge one step forward.
It looks smaller than me.
It stands two heads taller than me.
I'm waiting for one word from you.
I'm fixed on it, not moving.
I close in over the stones.
It slips into the gap in the rocks.
I don't mean to let it run.
I can hear its claws.
It's less than two paces away.
I crouch low, breath pressed to the ground.
My tail has gone stiff as a stick.
It charges straight at me.
I twist aside and its lunge misses.
I turn and grab at it.
I'm the one who keeps this slope.

lines.zh: 我的爪子带起碎石扫过去
lines.en: My paw sweeps in, scattering gravel.
I clamp my jaws on its foreleg.
I drive my whole shoulder into it.
I knock it away, off balance.
I drive up from below and flip it.
I shake my head to tear it away.
I shake my head and set my feet again.
Its blood spatters my face.
I open my mouth; my throat glows.
This bite comes with fire.
My charge knocks it back three steps.
I put my whole weight behind that swipe.
I jump down from the slope.
This place is thick with scents.
First I looked around.

lines.zh: 矿区那边有石头的声音。
lines.en: There's stone shifting over by the mine.
I shake the dust from my back.
I don't know where to go yet.
I crouch on the slope, waiting to be called.
These mountains are wide enough.
I smell cookfire smoke from camp.
My ears move before I land.
I've found open ground.
I start digging.
I'm not very afraid of fire.

lines.zh: 我从岩上摔下，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I fall off the rock and roll twice.
I swallow water and thrash all four paws.
A flash of fire and I land in the gravel.
An arrowhead is lodged in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 金色的光照住我，我动不了。
lines.en: Golden light holds me; I cannot move.
My belly's empty and my legs feel weak.
Lightning strikes and my whole body numbs.

lines.zh: 这里没有地面给我借力。
lines.en: There's no ground here to push against.
